messages:
incidentbot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert triggered (P1) for host gpu-node-47 (rack-7) — kernel panic followed by kubelet NotReady. PD: https://pagerduty.example/INC-27391

jose oncall: acked. I'm the primary; starting triage. tagging @ana oncall for handoff if this needs escalation.

sre-runbook-bot: matched runbook 'node-kernel-panic-handover'. recommended steps: collect serial-console, dmesg, /var/log/kern.log, attempt soft-reboot, cordon+drain. link: https://runbooks.internal/node-kernel-panic

jose oncall: quick checks: `kubectl get nodes gpu-node-47 -o wide` -> STATUS: NotReady, ROLES: gpu, AGE: 120d, VERSION: 1.26.

jose oncall: serial console shows oops stacktrace + CPU panic -> "BUG: unable to handle kernel NULL pointer dereference at 00000000". repeating stack until watchdog reset.

mike_sre: any customer impact observed? which tenants routed there?

jose oncall: initial telemetry: 3 live inference streams were interrupted and retried; spike of 504s for approx 25-40s. service-telemetry shows error rate bump for model-serving route in us-west-2. tentative impact: 2 paying customers (tenant-alpha, tenant-gamma) saw degraded tail latency.

lee_infra: if serial shows kernel oops, likely hardware/driver. I'll try a soft powercycle via IPMI first, hold for 60s, then hard if not back. starting ipmi power cycle now.

deploy-bot: Auto-evac plan triggered for pods on gpu-node-47. Suggested command: 
```
kubectl cordon gpu-node-47 && kubectl drain gpu-node-47 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --grace-period=300 --timeout=10m
```

jose oncall: cordoned node. starting drain. note: several long-running inference batches have PodDisruptionBudgets; drain honoring PDBs so some pods waiting.

ana oncall: I'll take the follow-up after the drain. jose, handoff to me when you start the IPMI/reboot steps. I'll open customer-impact thread and ping CS. :eyes:

jose oncall: handoff to ana oncall — ipmi reboot initiated by lee_infra at 6199991260. Drain progress: 5/7 pods evicted, 2 pending due to PDBs and hostpath mounts.

sre-runbook-bot: runbook note: if pods blocked by PDB >5m, either coordinate with owners to temporarily relax PDBs or force evict (last-resort).

ana oncall: contacting owners of stuck pods now. also prepping public incident note for affected customers.

lee_infra: node reboot completed at 6199991295, kubelet started but briefly reported NotReady while NVMe re-enumeration happened. kubelet now Ready? checking.

jose oncall: kubelet transitioned to Ready at 6199991302. post-reboot health checks: dmesg trimmed; no machine-check exceptions after reboot.

jose oncall: drain completed — remaining pods rescheduled onto other GPU nodes. verified model-serving route error-rate returned to baseline within ~2m.

mike_sre: thanks. I'm looping in CS (cc: @cs-rotation) to notify tenant-alpha and tenant-gamma with timeline + mitigation. Ana, can you own the customer comms?

ana oncall: got it. I'll publish customer note and start a short incident report. tagging @sre-runbook-bot to collect artifacts (serial log, kern.log, kubelet events).

sre-runbook-bot: collected artifacts attached to incident INC-27391: /artifacts/INC-27391/{serial.log,kern.log,kubelet-events.json}. recommended follow-up: mark for RMA if recurrence within 72h, otherwise continue monitoring.

mike_sre: next actions: 1) RMA evaluation, 2) add kernel oops fingerprint to incident tracker, 3) check driver versions on that rack for drift.

incidentbot: auto-update: PagerDuty incident INC-27391 auto-resolved (node came back). post-incident follow-up required.

ana oncall: filing postmortem and tagging infra for RMA evaluation. closing this thread for live mitigation. :white_check_mark:

jose oncall: leaving notes in oncall log, will follow-up tomorrow if infra requests serial deeper analysis. good handoff.

mike_sre: +1. Thanks team.
